BL-1491 — A supervisor alarm-and-halt kills all nine role sessions and the tmux server but writes no kill-all-audit row and no availability stop record: the audit log last saw a stop at 2026-09-07T06:12Z and the availability ledger holds two rows for 2026-09-08 while the swarm died four times that morning, so every death-detector the operator has reads a clean swarm; every halt records itself on both ledgers, write-ahead, through the same records kill_pipeline_swarm.sh leaves
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier from the same intake as BL-1490 and
  BL-1492. Grepped first: BL-823 (done) built the ledger and its two
  writers; BL-144 (done) built the halt; no ticket joins them.
- Article 3.2.4: type defect, severity high - expedited ordering.
- The intake reads "a superv…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: this ticket changes nothing about WHEN the supervisor halts (BL-1490)…
BL-1491 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1491" (or "reject BL-1491 <reason>") to act.
